reviews.comment: REQUEST CHANGES: (1) init reads the raw config and uses rolesDir/workDir without resolveConfig, so the new path confinement never runs on the init path — a cloned config with rolesDir '../../.claude/commands' + agents.extend writes attacker text outside the repo; export assertConfinedPaths and call it from init. (2) trust-hooks prints raw command strings — control chars (\r, ESC) can spoof the terminal review; print JSON.stringify(cmd).

fix.comment: Fixed blockers 1-2 (init confinement + spoofable trust-hooks print) and non-blocking #1-#6,#8,#10
